scope: Observed existing comic UI, live scout room plus built-in preview fixtures; no generated images

source.warning: Comic UI is in separate build and differs from canonical UI source. Logic links are references, not proof every latest backend rule has matching UI.

style.observedViewport: 1440×722 (browser native viewport; image dimensions recorded per file)
style.palette: near-black panels, white/cream text and borders, crimson primary controls; artwork retains merchant/item palette
style.measuredExamples: market detail buttons 44px height; some icon buttons48px; not a claim all controls are identical
style.layout: full-width HUD; bottom navigation; shared menu shells; 2-column appraisal;3merchant cards; inventory grid; left market navigation
style.art: existing comic/manhua cutouts over inked market background
style.overflow: 12 preview base captures observed scrollWidth/scrollHeight equal viewport; not an all-device check

limitations: Capture count is observed screen groups, not an exhaustive count of every conditional UI state.
Built-in previews render existing components but do not execute full backend logic.
No screenshot is generated art and no screenshot is a new design approval.
Current sample goods are not evidence that new56 catalog/effect bindings are complete.
Uncaptured and design-only screens are listed separately; do not generate replacements before checking source.
